import json,hashlib,pwd
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
p=json.loads(Path('schema/step28_alias_test_policy.json').read_text())
a=json.loads(Path('reports/seller_alias_continual/20260928/test_execution/20260928_165355/authorization.json').read_text())
def check(rec):
    path=Path(rec['path'])
    digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    actual={'path':rec['path'],'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest}
    if actual['bytes']!=rec['bytes'] or digest!=rec['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('File identity mismatch: '+rec['path'])
    return actual
sources=[check(rec) for rec in a['source_files']]
inputs=[check(rec) for rec in [p['data']['manifest'],p['data']['validation'],*p['data']['inputs'].values()]]
models=[]
for name,rec in p['models'].items():
    path=Path(rec['payload']['path'])
    st=path.stat()
    if st.st_size != rec['payload']['bytes']:
        raise ValueError('Model size mismatch')
    models.append({'role':name,'path':str(path),'bytes':st.st_size,'owner':pwd.getpwuid(st.st_uid).pw_name,'verification':'metadata only; actual model bytes will be verified by unchanged formal entry'})
failed=Path('reports/seller_alias_continual/20260928/test_execution/20260928_165355/execution/job')
